notes.title: Our new story - Blind Man's Sun.
notes.notes:
This time, we've teamed up with a writer (who’s also a mod creator and novelist) known as Alkinoy, and together we’ve created a story-driven novel with a non-abstract plot.
This time, the story is for mature audiences, featuring strong language, dark humor, trolling the players, and a moment straight out of Doki-Doki.

Hurry up and grab "Blind Man's Sun" while it's still on sale!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201610/Blind_Mans_Sun/]Link to novella page.[/url]
